reason: Eight implemented read-only GTM v2 inspection/audit tools are registered alongside other marketing products.
exposure: All 44 tools registered unconditionally after successful Google authentication; GTM_ACCOUNT_ID/GTM_CONTAINER_ID are needed by container operations. workspaceId overrides GTM_WORKSPACE_ID, otherwise first workspace is selected.
limitations: Offline tools/list used original registration functions with inert auth object and SDK in-memory transport; no handlers or Google operations were executed. Utility registration was extracted verbatim from index.js to avoid startup authentication.

Upstream package-lock.json is inconsistent with package.json (dotenv missing and Zod major mismatch); isolated npm install resolved package.json ranges. Resulting lockfile is saved in work directory, so schemas describe that resolved SDK/Zod implementation.
GTM list handlers do not paginate; audits may be incomplete for paginated results and treat variables referenced only by other variables as unused. Live credentialed functionality was not verified.

tools.name: sheets_read
tools.description: Read data from a Google Sheet. Accepts a full Sheets URL or a bare spreadsheet ID. Returns a 2D array of cell values. Defaults to the full sheet if no range is given.

url_or_id.description: Google Sheets URL or spreadsheet ID

range.description: A1 notation range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:D50". Defaults to all data.

tools.behavior: Google Sheets: calls spreadsheets.values.get and returns formatted API data or a caught API error.

tools.name: sheets_write
tools.description: Write or overwrite data in a Google Sheet at a specific range. Accepts a full Sheets URL or spreadsheet ID. Values are interpreted as if typed by a user (formulas, dates, and numbers are parsed automatically).

url_or_id.description: Google Sheets URL or spreadsheet ID

range.description: A1 notation range to write to, e.g. "Sheet1!A1"

values.description: 2D array of values to write, e.g. [["Name","Score"],["Alice",95]]

tools.behavior: Google Sheets: calls spreadsheets.values.update and returns formatted API data or a caught API error.

tools.name: sheets_append
tools.description: Append new rows to the end of existing data in a Google Sheet. Rows are added after the last row with content — existing data is never overwritten.

url_or_id.description: Google Sheets URL or spreadsheet ID

range.description: Sheet name or range indicating where to append, e.g. "Sheet1"

values.description: 2D array of rows to append, e.g. [["Bob",88],["Carol",91]]

tools.behavior: Google Sheets: calls spreadsheets.values.append and returns formatted API data or a caught API error.

tools.name: sheets_info
tools.description: Get metadata about a spreadsheet — its title, and for each sheet tab: the name, row count, and column count. Use before reading to confirm sheet names and size.

url_or_id.description: Google Sheets URL or spreadsheet ID

tools.behavior: Google Sheets: calls spreadsheets.get, map and returns formatted API data or a caught API error.

tools.name: sheets_clear
tools.description: Clear all values in a range of cells in a Google Sheet. Cell formatting is preserved — only the content is removed.

url_or_id.description: Google Sheets URL or spreadsheet ID

range.description: A1 notation range to clear, e.g. "Sheet1!A2:D100"

tools.behavior: Google Sheets: calls spreadsheets.values.clear and returns formatted API data or a caught API error.

tools.name: gtm_list_accounts
tools.description: List all GTM accounts accessible with the connected Google account. Use to find your GTM_ACCOUNT_ID if you do not know it.
tools.behavior: Calls Tag Manager v2 accounts.list and returns accessible account IDs, names and paths.

tools.name: gtm_list_containers
tools.description: List all GTM containers in the configured account. Use to find your GTM_CONTAINER_ID and the public GTM-XXXXXX ID.
tools.behavior: Calls Tag Manager v2 containers.list for GTM_ACCOUNT_ID and returns IDs, names and usage contexts.

tools.name: gtm_list_workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces in the configured GTM container. Returns workspace IDs and names. Use to find the workspaceId for other GTM tools.
tools.behavior: Calls Tag Manager v2 workspaces.list for the configured account and container.

tools.name: gtm_list_tags
tools.description: List all tags in a GTM workspace — name, type, firing triggers, and paused state. Defaults to the first workspace if workspaceId is not provided.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (default: first workspace in the container)

tools.behavior: Lists workspace tags and returns their IDs, types, paused states and firing/blocking trigger IDs.

tools.name: gtm_list_triggers
tools.description: List all triggers in a GTM workspace — name, type, and trigger ID. Defaults to the first workspace if workspaceId is not provided.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (default: first workspace in the container)

tools.behavior: Lists workspace triggers and returns their IDs, names and types.

tools.name: gtm_list_variables
tools.description: List all variables in a GTM workspace — name and type. Defaults to the first workspace if workspaceId is not provided.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (default: first workspace in the container)

tools.behavior: Lists workspace user-defined variables and returns IDs, names and types.

tools.name: gtm_get_tag
tools.description: Get full details for a single GTM tag by ID, including all parameters and trigger bindings. Use after gtm_list_tags to inspect a specific tag in depth.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (default: first workspace in the container)

tools.behavior: Gets one workspace tag and returns parameters, trigger bindings, notes and monitoring metadata.

tools.name: gtm_audit
tools.description: Audit a GTM workspace and return a structured report of issues: orphaned triggers (not used by any tag), duplicate tag names, and unused variables (not referenced by any tag or trigger). Defaults to the first workspace if workspaceId is not provided.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (default: first workspace in the container)

tools.behavior: Lists tags, triggers and variables, then flags unbound triggers, duplicate tag names and variables absent from serialized tag/trigger references; variable-to-variable references are not checked.

tools.name: psi_analyze
tools.description: Run a full PageSpeed Insights analysis on a URL. Returns Lighthouse category scores (performance, accessibility, best practices, SEO), lab Core Web Vitals (LCP, TBT, CLS, FCP, Speed Index, TTI), and real-world field data from CrUX if available. Defaults to mobile strategy.
tools.behavior: Calls PageSpeed Insights v5 and returns Lighthouse scores, lab metrics and available CrUX field metrics.

tools.name: psi_core_web_vitals
tools.description: Return Core Web Vitals for a URL — both lab measurements (from Lighthouse) and real-world field data (from CrUX, p75). Includes pass/fail category for each metric. Use to diagnose CWV issues or check if a page passes the CWV thresholds.
tools.behavior: Calls PageSpeed Insights v5 and returns lab/field metrics and a performance score; lab metrics are display strings, without computed pass/fail thresholds.

tools.name: psi_lighthouse
tools.description: Return the four Lighthouse category scores for a URL: performance, accessibility, best practices, and SEO. Scores are 0–100. Use for a quick quality check or to compare pages without needing the full Core Web Vitals breakdown.
tools.behavior: Calls PageSpeed Insights v5 and returns four category scores scaled to 0–100.

tools.name: psi_compare
tools.description: Analyse the same URL on both mobile and desktop simultaneously and return scores and Core Web Vitals side by side. Use to understand the performance gap between mobile and desktop experiences.

url.description: URL to analyse on both strategies

tools.behavior: Runs mobile and desktop PageSpeed Insights analyses concurrently and returns their scores and metrics.

tools.name: psi_bulk
tools.description: Analyse multiple URLs sequentially and return scores and Core Web Vitals for each. Requests are spaced 2 seconds apart to avoid rate limiting. Set PSI_API_KEY in your environment for higher rate limits — without a key, bulk analysis of more than a few URLs may be throttled.
tools.behavior: Calls PageSpeed Insights sequentially for each URL, collecting per-URL errors and delaying between requests.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check authentication status and confirm which Google account is connected. Run this first to verify the MCP server is working correctly.
tools.behavior: Calls Google OAuth2 v2 userinfo.get to report the connected email and available product groups.

tools.name: reauthenticate
tools.description: Clear the stored Google token and restart the login flow. Use this if you need to switch accounts or if authentication has stopped working.
tools.behavior: Deletes the saved OAuth token through clearToken; a server restart is required to begin login again.
